summary: Completed all 9 phases of the index-validation-truth plan. Fixed the four subshell-discarded counter blocks in validate-context-index.sh (added --strict flag and a REPO_ROOT-bypass preamble). Built generate-context-line-counts.sh and regenerated 320 stale/missing line_count values across 18 of 19 extensions (458/458 now exact), using surgical awk substitution after discovering a jq round-trip would have reformatted unrelated array styling. Converted M.append_index_entries to upsert semantics with a version/generated stamp -- confirmed the corrected line_count values now actually reach the deployed index on redeploy, which append-only semantics would have silently blocked. Indexed the 14 previously orphaned context files (11 core, 3 extension strays). Added Rule R (per-extension line_count accuracy) and Rule S (deployed-index-orphan) to check-extension-docs.sh, discovering mid-phase that the existing _git_deployed_files git-ls-files helper is vacuous in this repo (entirely gitignored .claude/) and building Rule S on direct filesystem enumeration instead. Synced documentation. Final verify-deploy.sh run: 12 checks, 0 failures. All three verification-bar criteria empirically demonstrated.
decisions_made: generate-context-line-counts.sh --write uses surgical line-oriented awk substitution/insertion rather than a jq round-trip, after a first attempt reformatted unrelated array styling across files using compact-array conventions (a 535-line diff for a 21-value change on nvim's index-entries.json alone).

The 94 'null' line_count entries are actually entirely-missing keys in six extensions (cslib, latex, lean, python, typst, z3), not literal JSON null values -- --write distinguishes insert (missing key) from replace (present-but-wrong) internally.

The core/lean same-path collision on three contracts/*.md files is an intentional lean4-specific override, not an accidental duplicate (different, purposeful content in each). Documented as a known dormant risk in append_index_entries's LuaDoc rather than deleted or rewritten; lean is not currently loaded so the collision is inert today.

Rule S (deployed-index-orphan) enumerates the filesystem directly (find -name '*.md') instead of the plan-assumed _git_deployed_files helper, after discovering that helper (git ls-files) always returns zero results against this repo's fully gitignored .claude/ tree -- a latent, pre-existing vacuity in Rule L as well, left unfixed as out of scope.

README.md/EXTENSION.md script-count summaries left untouched in Phase 8: neither enumerates scripts individually (both are already-stale abbreviated counts), so the new script is not left undocumented by omission -- its documentation surface is merge-sources/claudemd.md's Utility Scripts list, which was updated.
dead_ends: jq full-document round-trip for --write mode: silently reformats every array in files with non-canonical (compact) formatting, producing far more diff churn than the intended line_count-only change.
Reusing _git_deployed_files (git ls-files) for the new Rule S: silently vacuous in this repository because .claude/ is entirely gitignored with no tracked exceptions.
